main_text.l: scribes, consilium ubi audies meum. Recepi
ante biennium plus minus, & publicè re-
cepi, me id daturum operam ut universam
bus, id est discendi cupidis communicarem.
En specimen mei laboris! Præcognita nem-
pe philosophica eâ, quam temperatam esse
acroamatica est, ita tamen ut interdum sit
exoterica. Ibi scilicet ubi respostulat [?]. Pruden-
tiæ lex debet esse summa. Sed ita summa,
ut etiam sit sub summa, quæ est sapientiæ,
lege. Lex prudentiæ est summa, si respicia-
sonas. Lex sapientiæ est summa, si ipsarum

page.notes: The woodcut initial T is joined to the first word as "Titulus". The word "respostulat" is uncertain at the line end and is marked [?]. The final line "itaq;" stands alone at the right below the text and is taken as the catchword. The faint mirrored text at the upper right is show-through and is omitted. The ornamental border above the heading is not text and is omitted.
